prep: ChloraPrep (2% CHG / 70% IPA) - abdomen from xiphoid to pubis, bilaterally to midaxillary lines
sutures: 4-0 Monocryl PS-2 for subcuticular skin closure
notes: Prefers Hassan open cut-down for umbilical port. Defogger must be hot. Veress needle not used.

position: Supine with lateral leg positioner, thigh tourniquet
prep: DuraPrep 2-layer, foot isolated with sterile coban wrap
implants: Zimmer Persona Modular Cruciate Retaining (CR) Component
notes: Tourniquet inflated to 250 mmHg prior to skin incision. Vancomycin cement mixed at 14 minutes. Tranexamic acid (TXA) 1g IV given at start and deflation.

position: Supine with chest roll, bilateral legs externally rotated (frog-leg) with knee rolls
sutures: 6-0 Prolene C-1 for proximal aortic anastomoses
notes: Heparin 300 units/kg prior to cannulation; Target ACT > 480 sec. Cool chest with iced sterile saline slush.
